links.outcome: LLM accuracy on Chinese radiation oncology exam, international versus domestic models
links.effect: Qwen reached 86.30% accuracy, above the single physician reference (adjusted P = 0.020). International models declined markedly, failing on localized knowledge retrieval. English translation did not close the gap.
links.quote: In contrast, international models exhibited a marked performance decline in this specific context.

unlisted_practices: Using region-localized or domestically trained LLMs for region-specific clinical guideline knowledge

screen.reason: Evaluates domestic vs international LLMs on a Chinese radiation oncology specialty exam benchmark without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
